purpose: Maximum public nuclear placement panel for testing Japan-38, continental context and Ryukyu Arenicola before any new mainland sampling list is frozen.

correction.problem: v1 appended Chang 2025 and Chang 2026 source records independently even when the later paper reused the identical public BioSample/SRR.
correction.rule: One biological BioSample/SRR is one tree tip. Cross-paper reuse merges provenance and must never create a duplicate phylogenetic tip.

Chang2026.bioproject: PRJNA1311153 plus explicitly reused public runs

primary_analysis_order: recover all 294 biological tips into one validated Compositae1061 homolog space
retain all individuals for the initial global nuclear placement
infer concatenated and gene-tree/coalescent topology with paralog/homeolog sensitivity
map the 38 Moreyra Japanese paper concepts as a tested membership set, not a QC constraint
test Ryukyu Arenicola placement relative to the main Japanese radiation and continental branches
only after topology is stable identify branch-specific public-data gaps; do not freeze a new China sampling list now
